item.text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:43483",
      "quote": "opt-in prefix-cache-aware routing path for V1 internal data-parallel load balancing",
      "claim": "Author describes an internal DP routing mechanism that uses prompt-prefix information to choose a rank.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Internal/local DP; feature enabled explicitly.",
      "reported_result": "The PR reports 16 routing tests passed; it reports no serving latency or throughput result.",
      "transfer_inference": "A bounded, rank-aware router is plausible for a two-replica experiment if repeated prefixes reach the same rank and load remains balanced.",
      "limitations": "The PR is open, disabled by default, and provides no B200 R7b result. The baseline's implemented routing is unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:43483",
      "quote": "Does not implement cross-DP KV import or warmup.",
      "claim": "The proposed router cannot recover a prefix cached only on another rank through KV transfer.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Requests move between ranks or a chosen rank lacks the prefix.",
      "reported_result": "No transfer or warmup result is reported.",
      "transfer_inference": "A load override may lose affinity's benefit; bound affinity by rank load and measure served cache hits alongside tail latency.",
      "limitations": "The supplied PR does not quantify the cost of misses or load imbalance."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:58757",
      "quote": "route requests to *individual* DP engines within a deployment",
      "claim": "The documentation PR describes rank-level session affinity as a distinct routing capability.",
      "relation": "context",
      "conditions": "vLLM Router with `--intra-node-data-parallel-size N` and `consistent_hash`.",
      "reported_result": "Documentation-only change; markdown lint passed. No serving result is reported.",
      "transfer_inference": "Endpoint affinity alone does not establish that follow-up requests reach the same DP rank.",
      "limitations": "No evidence identifies the rank selected by the B200 R7b baseline."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2608.19677v1",
      "quote": "Cache-blind balancing disperses that reuse; fixed affinity preserves it but can overload a server.",
      "claim": "The paper's abstract states the cache reuse versus load fairness tradeoff motivating bounded affinity.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Repeated requests share a recoverable prefix that remains resident.",
      "reported_result": "This quote is an abstract-level mechanism claim, not implementation evidence.",
      "transfer_inference": "Compare bounded affinity with load-only routing at matched offered load, including per-rank utilization, served KV hits, TTFT, and tail latency.",
      "limitations": "It does not establish gains on two B200 replicas or the R7b workload."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2608.19677v1",
      "quote": "On a 70B fp8 model across 60 H100 GPUs, it reaches 93.2% served KV hit and 2.3× the capacity of the strongest baseline at a 3.5-s p99 SLO.",
      "claim": "The paper reports a routing benefit under its evaluated large-scale conditions.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "70B fp8; 60 H100 GPUs; 3.5-second p99 SLO.",
      "reported_result": "Author-reported 93.2% served KV hit and 2.3× capacity versus its strongest baseline.",
      "transfer_inference": "The result justifies testing prefix-aware routing, but supplies no B200 effect-size estimate.",
      "limitations": "The supplied excerpt does not identify the strongest baseline or show two-replica behavior."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2608.19677v1",
      "quote": "affinity can reduce capacity when the recoverable prefix work is small",
      "claim": "The paper reports a negative-transfer boundary for prefix affinity.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Little prefix work is recoverable.",
      "reported_result": "The excerpt names negative workloads but gives no numerical result for them.",
      "transfer_inference": "Load-only routing may win on the B200 R7b workload if exact-prefix reuse is low or affinity creates rank skew.",
      "limitations": "Recoverable prefix work and rank-level load skew for the target workload are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:52906",
      "quote": "if N_p >= N_th and N_d > 0:\n    prefill_budget = B_cap\nelse:\n    prefill_budget = B_max",
      "claim": "The RFC specifies a conditional prefill cap based on concurrent prefill and decode pressure.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "Evaluated settings stated in the RFC: threshold 2, maximum 16,384, cap 2,048.",
      "reported_result": "This is a proposed policy, not evidence that it is present in the baseline.",
      "transfer_inference": "It could protect decode ITL during mixed-load periods while retaining larger prefills at low pressure.",
      "limitations": "The target scheduler state, workload mix, and B200 response are unknown."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:52906",
      "quote": "reduced average end-to-end latency by 8.5% relative to fixed MBT 2k and by 11.3% relative to fixed MBT 16k",
      "claim": "The RFC author reports an adaptive-policy gain over two fixed budgets in its main load sweep.",
      "relation": "supports",
      "conditions": "The RFC describes experiments across models, workloads, and RTX 5090, A100, and H100 GPUs.",
      "reported_result": "Author-reported average end-to-end latency improvement: 8.5% versus fixed 2k and 11.3% versus fixed 16k. Of those two, fixed 2k is stronger.",
      "transfer_inference": "A fair B200 R7b comparison must first identify the strongest fixed budget on that same workload and objective.",
      "limitations": "The excerpt does not establish that 2k is the strongest fixed budget overall, or report a B200 R7b gain."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2608.15171v1",
      "quote": "its magnitude depends on the model–hardware configuration",
      "claim": "The P-PAS paper qualifies the size of budget sensitivity by model and hardware.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Transfer from evaluated hardware and workloads to B200 R7b.",
      "reported_result": "The supplied conclusion gives no B200 R7b effect size.",
      "transfer_inference": "A crossover between large and small budgets is a hypothesis to test locally, not an expected gain.",
      "limitations": "The supplied fulltext excerpt is gapped; detailed hardware results are unavailable here."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "github:vllm-project/vllm:56848",
      "quote": "keeping decode ITL at the pure-decode level, at the cost of higher prefill TTFT / lower prefill throughput",
      "claim": "A separate decode-priority scheduler proposal states the TTFT and ITL tradeoff that a prefill cap must be checked against.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "High concurrency with active decode and limited KV cache; this proposal uses cadence, not the adaptive budget policy.",
      "reported_result": "The PR author reports decode throughput below 1 to 8 tokens/s and prefill throughput about 2,500 to 1,600 tokens/s on Qwen3.8-27B TP2.",
      "transfer_inference": "Measure TTFT and prefill throughput as well as ITL when evaluating adaptive budgets.",
      "limitations": "The PR is closed and unmerged; its cadence result does not quantify P-PAS or B200 R7b."
    },
    {
      "source_id": "fulltext:2609.07883v1",
      "quote": "starvation and admission control deserve separate study",
      "claim": "An adaptive chunking paper identifies a fairness risk left outside its evaluation.",
      "relation": "challenges",
      "conditions": "Mixed requests with competing latency objectives.",
      "reported_result": "No starvation or fairness result is supplied in the excerpt.",
      "transfer_inference": "Check per-request wait time and long-tail TTFT so a lower average latency does not hide delayed prefills.",
      "limitations": "This is a different adaptive controller; its caveat is not a measured failure of P-PAS."
    }
  ],
  "unanswered": [
    "What routing and prefill-budget features are actually enabled in the B200 R7b two-replica DP4 baseline?",
    "Does endpoint affinity map requests to a stable DP rank in that baseline?",
    "How much exact-prefix work is recoverable, and how often do useful prefixes remain resident on each rank?",
    "What is the strongest fixed prefill budget on the target workload under the same TTFT, ITL, throughput, and fairness objectives?",
    "What are the B200 R7b effect sizes and tail-latency tradeoffs for either mechanism versus load-only routing and the strongest fixed budget?",
    "How do bounded affinity and adaptive budgets affect per-rank load fairness, request starvation, and preemption under the target workload?"
  ]
}
